Everyone's back at Kyogokudo. Toriguchi reports on Onbako-sama, and Sekiguchi-kun and Enokizu go to Yoriko's...
Of all people, those two？ This might be dangerous...
The oddball duo stopped Yoriko's mom from suicide. That was hilarious.
But if the confession in that apology letter is true... Hmm, now I'm completely lost.
Kiba-san went to see Yoko and things got a little sweet... Oh right, and lots of rumors about the gloved monster.
Her classmates gossiping about Yoriko-chan felt so real, I felt awful for her...
Everyone gathered, and Kyogokudo-san deduced the link to Kubo and named the dismemberment killer.
Though I already figured that out ages ago. Hmmm...
Kyogokudo-san is deducing when Yoriko attacked Kanako, and then, another severed arm...
Could this arm be... wait, no, it definitely is... Aww, I knew this was coming, but still...
Onbako-sama and Kyogokudo finally faced off. Enokizu-san is actually super helpful♪
Oh yeah, the second part of "Girl in the Box" came up. Knowing it's a diary makes it way too creepy...
We found out Kubo and Onbako-sama are parent and child, and then Aoki-kun stormed into the box house...
"Crammed in tight"... *sigh* I might have nightmares about that tonight...
Kubo ended up chopped up too, and Kyogokudo-san raided the box building with everyone...

Kanako's real father is someone else, and the building is a giant artificial body...

So Kanako really was Yoko's sister. Wow, this is so complicated...
With the doctor and Yoko holding Kubo— Wait, just a bit more... It's the climax...!
